title: AI hallucinations in 60 seconds
caption: AI hallucinations in 60 seconds: why language models state false things with total confidence. #ai #llm #chatgpt

scenes.title: Hallucinations
scenes.say: Why does AI state made-up facts with total confidence?
Ask a model for sources, and it might give you a book with a real-sounding title, a real author, and no existence.

items.title: Predict
items.say: A model writes the most likely next words.

items.title: Plausible
items.say: Likely and true usually overlap. Sometimes they don't.

items.title: No 'I don't know'
items.text: unless it's trained to say it
items.say: And it doesn't know which is which unless it's trained to.

items.title: Ground it
items.say: Give it the source to work from.

items.title: Ask for citations
items.say: Ask for citations, and check them.

scenes.say: That's a hallucination. Fluent isn't the same as true.
